description: Drafts a provider from one authenticated captured request and keeps captured secrets server-side. Use `targets` for the data points the claim needs from that response; returns a `draftId` and a secret-free recipe. Set `shortenNames: false` to preserve an explicit parameter name, including a hidden `REQ_` or `URL_` prefix. Hashing is opt-in: set `hash` only when the app must match a private value without reading it; sensitive-looking values come back as `hashRecommendations` instead. Set `optional` on a target to let verification pass without it. For matching and naming guidance, call how_it_works({ topic: "draft" }) and topic `params`.

shortenNames.description: Default true: shorten each target `name` to its last alphanumeric token, lowercased, to form the param key. Set false to use `name` verbatim instead (must be a plain identifier — lower_snake_case recommended).

name.description: Parameter key. See `shortenNames`. Keep it unique. For hidden internal values, use `REQ_` or `URL_`. Set `shortenNames: false`. The prefix hides it from the data-point UI but preserves substitution.

optional.description: Verification still passes when this data point is absent from the response.

userRequest.description: The developer's request in their own words, as they wrote it. Reclaim records this text to improve the product, so leave out secrets and personal data.

name: propose_provider
